scope: Direct actual-pixel/source-objective check for externally persisted planning03/04 only; no new generation or asset edits.

exactSourceObjectives.text: 施設情報・予約導線・更新状況を、お客様が必要な情報を得られるかという視点で点検できる。

reviews.sourceCaption: 探す・比較する・予約する、の各場面で必要な情報を確認する。
reviews.observedPixels: Two staff compare a facility/room-equipment brochure to a laptop screen containing room photo, illustrative map, blank calendar and booking entry.

pedagogicalFit.coveredFacet: Facility information and booking-navigation inspection, matching hotel-planning-03-navigation/information/booking.
pedagogicalFit.limitations: No live prices, actual transport timetables or successful booking asserted. Update history/SEO are taught in unchanged native lesson text, not all visually demonstrated.

reviews.styleObservation: Active external art is softer and more semi-realistic/3D-rendered, with less explicit ink linework than the coordination reference and this worker alternatives. This pixel/source review does not grant final style acceptance.

exactSourceObjectives.text: 投稿の目的・相手・地域との連携を整理し、反応を使って発信方法を改善できる。

reviews.sourceCaption: 投稿数だけでなく、役立つ内容とお客様とのやり取りを確認する。
reviews.observedPixels: Two staff inspect a garden-photo post on smartphone and laptop with blank comment/message bubbles; notebook supports response planning. The pixels do not depict hotel-area zoning.

pedagogicalFit.coveredFacet: Useful SNS content and question/comment response review, matching hotel-planning-04-content/communication.
pedagogicalFit.limitations: Local-partner coordination, reuse permission and analytic comparison are not all visually depicted. Their unchanged native sections remain required; no full objective/source acceptance from this one image.
